judgements.justification: Each committee got its own new results (A: 10-seed runs and an architecture re-run; B: the YOEO table) that raised its scores; the exchange was symmetric, and without the outliers both panels end at 7, 7, 8.
Every B reviewer had confidence 4, and no lone high-confidence expert was outweighed in either committee.
No reviewer added an objection after the response period; wwer never edited its review, and the edits that occurred raised scores.
The core panels gave the same 7, 7, 8 for the same praise; the gap comes from two individual outliers (R03, R12), not committee-wide scoring leniency.
Both committees found the superiority claim overstated (T3oZ in A, yZ2w in B), and B's two-sentence meta-review does not cap the tier on it.
No reviewer said they could not check the core; B's ratings are 7, 7, 8 at confidence 4, plus wwer's 3, not flat marginal accepts.
